messageBar: Election Day is Tuesday, November 3. Make your plan to vote!
tagline: Join the movement and wear your activism on your sleeve - literally! Original designs for people who believe in democracy. Get ready to protest in style!
aboutShort: I Want My Democracy is an independent shop of original designs by Fauber Design. Every shirt, mug and sticker is a small way to say it out loud: democracy is worth showing up for.
aboutText:
I Want My Democracy is an independent shop of original designs by Fauber Design.

Every design starts with a simple idea: democracy belongs to all of us, and it's worth standing up for, in the voting booth, in our communities, and yes, on our T-shirts.

Our products are printed on demand and shipped by our partners, Redbubble and TeePublic. Pick your favorite design on this site, then choose your product, size and color on either store.
